philippines.title: Cuna: Renewable energy vital to sovereignty, national security
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Transitioning to renewable power is essential to protecting the Philippines against international supply shocks and geopolitical instability, Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna told senior decision-makers during New York Climate Week. Cuna made that remark on Sept. 20 as part of his keynote address at a high-level reception hosted by Danish green fund manager Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) in Manhattan. “The world is navigating an era of complex geopolitical change, where the traditional paradigms of national security are rapidly evolving,” Cuna said, as quoted in a statement issued on Tuesday by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR). philippines.title: Marcos, Angara honor exemplary teachers during Metrobank awards event
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and Education Secretary Sonny Angara praised on Tuesday two teachers who were among the recipients of the 2026 Metrobank Foundation Outstanding Filipinos awards, during a conferment ceremony at Malacañan Palace. The recognition coincided with the national observance of National Teachers’ Month, as a statement issued by the Department of Education pointed out. The two awardees are basic education teachers — Dr. Emmanuel D. Guarde of Oriental Mindoro and Engineer Sheila Marie M. Amigo of Zamboanga Sibugay, who were recognized for “pioneering achievements in localized, culture-based learning and interactive science education.” READ: Marcos honors 10 […]...

philippines.title: EJ Obiena says he fell on wet runway before Asian Games gold
philippines.description:
READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA, Japan —EJ Obiena slipped and fell on a rain-soaked pole vault runway during practice before recovering to win gold for the Philippines at the Asian Games 2026. Morning rain had made the runway at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium slick, and Obiena said a misstep caused the fall. The accident scraped his left arm and left visible burns hours before the men’s pole vault competition. “Some slippage. I had an accident this morning.
